raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Port the two new GLM-5.2-w8a8 4-node 2P2D accuracy test cases from Ascend/sglang#1296 into the community repo, and clean up the duplicated evalscope retry logic shared by the NPU accuracy test bases.

## Modifications

- Add `test/registered/npu/accuracy/glm5_2/test_npu_glm_5_2_w8a8_2p2d_32p_dcp_gpqa.py` (decode side: tp32/dp8/dcp4) and `test/registered/npu/accuracy/glm5_2/test_npu_glm_5_2_w8a8_2p2d_32p_pcp_gpqa.py` (prefill side: attn-cp8). Both extend `TestNpuAccuracyMultiNodePdSepTestCaseBase` with `max_retries = 1` and are registered with `disabled="accuracy testcase"` for now.
- Refactor the ~100%-duplicated evalscope retry loop previously copy-pasted in all three NPU accuracy base classes (`test_npu_accuracy_utils.py`) into one shared `run_evalscope_with_retry` helper (net -41 lines).
- PdMix/PdSep base classes now honor the per-case `max_retries` class attribute (previously only the single-node base consumed it, so the override in PdSep subclasses like kimi_k3 gpqa was dead code).
- Add structured `[retry-budget]` logging that records the retry budget source and the actual attempts consumed per case, easing nightly triage.

## Accuracy Tests

Validated on the nightly NPU multi-node POC pipeline (run https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41107271816):

- `pcp_gpqa` case passed: accuracy **0.909** vs baseline 0.912, finished after 1/1 attempt (`[retry-budget] ... finished after 1/1 attempt(s), best accuracy=0.909`).
- `dcp_gpqa` case cannot start on current main: upstream hard-rejects the DSA + DCP + PD-disaggregation combination (`ValueError: DSA DCP does not support PD disaggregation.` in `deepseek_v2.py`). Both cases are registered `disabled`, so they do not run in suites until enabled.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -297,6 +297,65 @@ def assert_metrics(self, metrics):
         )
 
 
+def run_evalscope_with_retry(
+    self,
+    host,
+    port,
+    model_name,
+):
+    """Shared evalscope retry loop for all accuracy test bases.
+
+    Retries up to ``max_retries`` (class attribute override, or
+    ``get_max_retries`` by dataset), keeping the best accuracy.
+    """
+    max_retries = (
+        self.max_retries
+        if self.max_retries is not None
+        else get_max_retries(self.datasets)
+    )
+    logger.info(
+        f"[retry-budget] {type(self).__name__}: max_retries={max_retries} "
+        f"(class override: {self.max_retries is not None}), "
+        f"datasets={self.datasets}, threshold baseline={self.accuracy}"
+    )
+    best_metrics = None
+    attempts_used = 0
+    for attempt in range(max_retries):
+        attempts_used = attempt + 1
+        metrics = run_evalscope(
+            host=host,
+            port=port,
+            model=model_name,
+            datasets=self.datasets,
+            dataset_args=self.dataset_args,
+            eval_batch_size=self.eval_batch_size,
+            limit=self.limit,
+            generation_config=self.generation_config,
+            dataset_dir=self.dataset_dir,
+            stream=self.stream,
+            timeout=self.timeout,
+            eval_type=self.eval_type,
+        )
+        if best_metrics is None or float(metrics.get("accuracy", 0)) > float(
+            best_metrics.get("accuracy", 0)
+        ):
+            best_metrics = metrics
+        threshold = get_accuracy_threshold(self.datasets, self.accuracy)
+        if float(best_metrics.get("accuracy", 0)) >= threshold:
+            break
+        if attempt < max_retries - 1:
+            logger.info(
+                f"Accuracy {best_metrics.get('accuracy')} below threshold "
+                f"{threshold}, retrying ({attempt + 1}/{max_retries - 1})..."
+            )
+    logger.info(
+        f"[retry-budget] {type(self).__name__}: finished after "
+        f"{attempts_used}/{max_retries} attempt(s), "
+        f"best accuracy={best_metrics.get('accuracy') if best_metrics else None}"
+    )
+    assert_metrics(self, best_metrics)
+
